"Sunset Boulevard" is indeed a musical by Andrew Lloyd Webber, based on the 1950 Billy Wilder film. The musical had its world premiere in London in 1993, and the US premiere occurred in Los Angeles at the Shubert Theatre on December 9, 1993 (with previews), with the official opening on December 9th or 10th, 1993, before moving to Broadway in 1994.

The date of December 10th, 1993 aligns with the Los Angeles premiere of "Sunset Boulevard." This was a major production starring Glenn Close.
